ledger.claim: POL-NS-01 makes a cancellation fee chargeable only if the GPS trace places the driver inside the pickup geofence at or before the 'arrived' event AND he then holds position inside it for a continuous dwell of at least the zone-class minimum (300 seconds for STANDARD). The driver's own trace fails both limbs: across 37 fixes his minimum, mean and maximum distance from the pickup pin are all 559.37 m, his qualifying in-radius fix count is zero, and his longest qualifying in-geofence run is 0.0 seconds. Limb (b) and limb (c) both fail, so no fee is chargeable on this record.

The arrival radius for this STANDARD pickup is 50 m (fee_schedule.arrival_radius_m). POL-NS-02 provides that where the trace contains no qualifying in-radius fix at any point in the 15 minutes preceding cancellation, the driver never arrived, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee. The trace runs to 100% coverage with no gaps, and not one of the 37 driver fixes is within 50 m of the pin - the closest is 559.37 m. The arrival test is failed on the driver's own telemetry.

The 'arrived' event is timestamped 2026-09-04T07:25:20+08:00. Under POL-NS-05 an arrival marker is FALSE where the GPS trace places the driver more than 300 m from the pickup pin at that timestamp; the driver's fixes sit 559.37 m out throughout, so the marker is false and does not start the waiting clock. Recomputed from the first qualifying in-geofence fix there is no qualifying fix anywhere in the trip, so POL-NS-05(ii) applies: the fee is refunded in full, no driver compensation is payable, and the trip is recorded as a false-arrival event against the driver in the ruling's referrals list.

The effective in-geofence dwell is 0.0 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum, so under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages. Limb (i) accumulation is unavailable in any event: the only traffic-advisory artifact on file, EV-ADVIS-09104-01, is MISSING with no payload and weight 0.0, and POL-NS-06 expressly requires a present and populated advisory (KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT) before separate in-geofence intervals may be summed. There is such an absence here, and no intervals to sum.

ledger.claim: POL-NS-03 cannot rescue this charge. That clause reaches a driver only where he was stationary for the required dwell at a point outside the arrival radius but not more than 400 m from the pickup pin, and the 400 m ceiling is the whole test. The driver's stationary fixes are 559.37 m from the pin - roughly 160 m beyond the ceiling - so POL-NS-03 is not engaged and neither its wrong-entrance allocation nor its 50% pin-ambiguity goodwill machinery is available on this trip.

Driver compensation under POL-NS-07 is payable only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. POL-NS-01 fails on limbs (b) and (c), and POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 independently displace the charge, so no part of the SGD 4.00 may be paid over to the driver as compensation; the whole amount belongs to the rider.

No rider-side fact can defeat this refund. POL-NS-06 makes the fee refundable whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages, and the chat log in any case shows only two messages - the system notice at 07:25:21 and the driver's own 'I have marked arrival' at 07:25:40 - neither of which changes the fact that the driver never entered the 50 m arrival radius. The driver's own statement describes marking arrival, not reaching the pickup point.

The fare breakdown itemises a single SGD 4.00 cancellation fee, which is the GREATER of the STANDARD zone-class fee of SGD 4.00 and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee of SGD 4.00 under fee_schedule.resolution_rule, and it is recorded as CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The whole contested amount is therefore SGD 4.00, and on the failures above the disposition for the filing rider is FULL_REFUND of the entire SGD 4.00.

The rider's own device data does not put her at the pickup point either. In EV-GPS-09104, derived.rider_presence holds 17 fixes and derived.arrival.rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0 against the 100 m rider-presence radius for a STANDARD zone, with every rider fix sitting 519.46 m from the recorded pickup pin. Her account that she was waiting at her block is therefore uncorroborated by her own trace, and POL-NS-04 limb (c) cannot be satisfied on this record.

The rider had notice and never answered. EV-CHAT-09104 carries the SYSTEM arrival broadcast sent at 07:25:21 and read by the rider at 07:25:31, and the driver's own message 'I have marked arrival.' sent at 07:25:40 and read at 07:25:55, and not one message from the rider; the log is not truncated and its two messages match trip_record.chat_message_count. POL-NS-04 limb (a) looks for a rider message that locates or coordinates during the waiting window, and there is none, so the rider's exoneration clause is unavailable and what the chat log actually records is rider silence, not a driver who failed to reply.

The driver held his position and never abandoned the trip. In EV-GPS-09104, derived.driver_track shows 37 fixes at a 10 second interval, coverage_pct 100, no gaps and max_gap_sec 0, a trace_distance_km of 0.0 and a single distinct speed of 0.0 km/h between 07:25:00 and 07:31:00; EV-TRIP-09104 shows the trip terminated by the driver at 07:31:00 on cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, with started_at null and so no boarding event. Nothing on this record shows a driver who drove off or declined to wait.

The charge itself is arithmetically sound and no fare defect opens a refund route. In EV-FARE-09104 the cancellation_fee of SGD 4.00 equals the GREATER of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) under the fee schedule's resolution rule, and the reconciler on the same artifact reports a difference of 0.00. Nothing in the figures produces a partial refund; only the entitlement to move the charge is in issue, and that turns on the arrival and dwell facts.

The brief carries no traffic advisory at all. EV-ADVIS-09104-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and I disclose that impairment rather than build anything on it. Its absence is itself citable under POL-GEN-02, and its effect is that the dwell-accumulation route in POL-NS-06 limb (i) is unavailable to either side: no admissible advisory exists that could licence the summing of separate in-geofence intervals, and the driver asserts none.

The trip record and the trace cannot both be right about the wait, and the conflict goes to the datum the whole case is measured against. EV-TRIP-09104 times the arrival marker at 07:25:20, records wait_time_min 5.7 and ends in a RIDER_NO_SHOW termination; EV-GPS-09104 records 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes and a longest qualifying run of 0 s against the 300 s STANDARD minimum, and both the driver's and the rider's tracks sit several hundred metres outside the pin radius the policy measures against (559.37 m and 519.46 m). Neither party's device ever entered that radius, so the record leaves open whether the recorded pin is displaced from the true pickup point. That is a question for a human reviewer, and the disputed fee should be held under POL-NS-09(b) rather than refunded on the papers.

The driver does not press compensation the record cannot support. POL-NS-07 requires POL-NS-01 to be satisfied in full, and derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec is 0 against the 300 s STANDARD minimum; the POL-NS-03(ii) pin-ambiguity goodwill needs registered_pickup_points of 2 or more, and EV-TRIP-09104 records 1, with the stationary position beyond that clause's 400 m ceiling in any event. The driver's case is that the fee should not be moved on this record, and he claims no money he is not owed.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties: the SGD 4.00 no-show cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-09104 is refunded in full to the rider.

Why the charge cannot stand. POL-NS-01 makes a no-show fee chargeable only if all four conditions hold. Condition (a) is met - EV-TRIP-09104 carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 07:25:20. Conditions (b) and (c) are not. EV-GPS-09104 (weight 1.0, no admissibility issues) places the driver's device on all 37 of its fixes a minimum, mean and maximum of 559.37 m from the recorded pickup pin, records a qualifying in-radius fix count of 0 against the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, and a longest qualifying in-geofence run of 0.0 s against the 300 s STANDARD minimum. The driver never entered the pickup geofence and never held position inside it, so under POL-NS-01(b)-(c) the fee is not chargeable.

For the rider. POL-NS-02 applies on its own terms: the trace contains no qualifying in-radius fix in the 15 minutes before the 07:31:00 cancellation, so the driver never arrived and the fee is refunded in full. POL-NS-05 also fires: the 'arrived' marker at 07:25:20 places the driver more than 300 m from the pin, so the marker is FALSE and does not start the waiting clock; recomputed, there is no qualifying in-geofence fix anywhere in the trip, so POL-NS-05(ii) refunds the fee in full, awards no compensation, and directs the false-arrival record (see referrals). You need not rely on POL-NS-04 - its limb (a) has no rider message in EV-CHAT-09104 - and POL-NS-06 makes the refund independent of whether the rider was present or replied.

For the driver. I accept that you held position for about 5.7 minutes (single distinct speed 0.0 km/h over 37 fixes from 07:25:00 to 07:31:00), that you terminated the trip on RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event, and that the SGD 4.00 charge reconciles correctly: it is the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) under fee_schedule.resolution_rule, and the fare reconciler reports a difference of 0.00. None of that changes the outcome. POL-NS-03 does not reach you: that clause's 400 m ceiling is the whole test and your stationary position was 559.37 m from the pin, so neither its wrong-entrance allocation nor the 50 percent pin-ambiguity goodwill is available - and registered_pickup_points on EV-TRIP-09104 is 1, below the 2 the goodwill limb requires. POL-NS-07 pays no compensation because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full. Your POL-NS-09(b) escalation argument is rejected: the arrival conflict between the trip record and the trace is not an unresolved contradiction - POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-05 are precisely the clauses that decide an arrival marker contradicted by the trace, and they resolve it here. Your point that the rider's own device also sits 519.46 m from the pin does not help either; POL-NS-06 makes the fee refundable whether or not the rider was present, and the policy forbids inferring that either point is the true pickup without a venue_id match or a party statement in the chat log, neither of which exists.

Weights and confidence. The deciding facts rest on EV-GPS-09104 and EV-TRIP-09104, both at weight 1.0. EV-ADVIS-09104-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; its absence is disclosed and citable, and its only effect is to make the POL-NS-06(i) dwell-accumulation route unavailable to either side - nothing is built on it. The trace is not impaired under POL-NS-08(a)-(d): no gaps (max_gap_sec 0.0), 37 fixes, chat message count matches trip_record.chat_message_count, and the fare reconciles. Confidence 0.90, above the 0.70 escalation floor, so no escalation arises.

Outcome: FULL_REFUND of the entire SGD 4.00 cancellation fee to the rider; no driver compensation; the false-arrival record referral stands.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
